requiredFindings.title: Escape the D3a reason separator inside the D-family table row
requiredFindings.detail: The new evidence text contains an unescaped pipe in "{reason: io-failure with its errno (K2 Errno) | work-exhausted with no errno}". The four-column table previously had five delimiter pipes on this row; r107 has six. In a GFM table the added pipe ends the Evidence cell. The remainder beginning "work-exhausted with no errno}" occupies Next action, while the intended next-action cell beginning "D1a (macOS), D2a and D2b-1 are accepted and bound" is an extra cell and is ignored. The rendered board therefore loses the intended open-work sequence and disagrees with unit-register.json even though the source text is present.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Escape this pipe as \| in the Markdown table, or express the alternatives using "or". Keep the JSON evidence text semantically identical. Confirm the D row has four cells and that the intended D1a-L/D2b/D3a/D3b/D4/D5 next action occupies its final cell; regenerate affected subject pins.
